changeSummary: Added: Network VPN Scanner with explicit CIDR selection, progress, cancellation, reverse DNS, MAC availability, IEEE/offline vendor lookup, and CSV/JSON export.
Changed: Profile Config now opens in a dedicated Basic/Advanced popup.
Changed: Tray Panel and Main connection summary now use a compact VPN-first hierarchy.
Security: Default routes are blocked; normal scans are capped at 256 addresses and larger ranges require Admin Mode.
Fixed: Bounded DNS concurrency and progress pushes prevent large scans from stalling the client.
